sentence: I told the agent I said I was looking for a flat near the school.
synonym: mentioned I wanted to find an apartment
synonymNote: 两者都表示告诉别人自己在找公寓，意思相同。

distractors.word: asked I was renting a house
distractors.note: ask表示询问，不是陈述自己在找房子。

distractors.word: said I was buying a flat
distractors.note: buying是购买，不是looking for（寻找/租用）。

distractors.word: said I was leaving a flat
distractors.note: leaving是离开，与寻找公寓意思相反。
